The '''''Leopard''''' was a [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

==History==
The '''Leopard''' was part of a strike force to [[Battle of RS-32|capture]] [[XQ4 Platform]] [[RS-32]] as the station contained [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|Mag Pulse]] technology, that the Empire wanted during the [[Zaarin insurrection]]. When the station's shields were down and the platform disabled by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]. The ''Leopard'' was the first transport to bring troops to capture the platform. Once the troops departed, the transport exited the battle into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].
